indicator_name: Receipts of the state and republican budgets by budget classification code (category, class, subclass, specific), year-to-date, million KZT
description: Поступления государственного и республиканского бюджетов по кодам бюджетной классификации (категория, класс, подкласс, специфика), с начала года, млн тенге
unit: million KZT, January to the month
methodology: Minfin Statistical Bulletin «табл 4» (state budget, items STATE.*) and «табл 8 (дох)» (republican budget, REP.*): every row of the table. Item code = budget + the classification code: TOTAL («ПОСТУПЛЕНИЯ»), REVENUE («ДОХОДЫ»), one digit = category (1 tax, 2 non-tax, 3 sale of fixed capital, 4 special receipts, 5 transfers, 6 repayment of budget loans, 7 sale of financial assets), three digits = class (101 income tax, 103 social tax, 104 property, 105 domestic taxes on goods and services, 106 international trade, 107 other, 108 state duty), four = subclass (1011 corporate income tax, 1012 personal income tax, 1051 VAT, 1052 excises, 1053 natural-resource payments, 1061 customs payments), six = specific (the full budget code, e.g. 105101 VAT on domestic goods, 105306 mineral extraction tax of the non-oil sector, 106110 export duty on crude oil). Checked in every edition: specifics sum to the subclass, subclasses to the class, classes to the category, categories 1-5 to REVENUE and 1-7 to TOTAL; a break stops the load. CATEGORY NUMBERS ARE THE 2026 ONES IN EVERY YEAR: the 2026 Budget Code inserted «Специальные поступления» as category 4 and moved transfers 4 -> 5, repayment of loans 5 -> 6, sale of financial assets 6 -> 7; the loader recognises a category by its name and renumbers the 2025 rows, so STATE.5 is transfers throughout (in the 2025 files it is printed as 4). Specifics are NOT renumbered and a few were reused: 105316 is the fee for negative environmental impact in 2025 and the fee for plant resources from 2026 (the environmental fee moved to 401101); 201907 and 204110 changed meaning within 2025 -- read item_name of the row, it is the label of that edition. A line with no receipts in a period is absent from the table, not zero. Receipts of the oil sector to the National Fund are not here (NF_* scalars). LOCAL budgets = STATE minus REP only for taxes; transfers between levels are inside REP.5 and not inside STATE. HISTORY from 2013-01, loaded on 2026-11-13 by the backfill workflow (.github/workflows/backfill-bulletins.yml; what each edition gave is in reports/backfill_minfin_bulletins.md): state budget 154 months, republican 159. In the older editions: (a) until 2021 the table also carried borrowing and the use of budget balances, stored as categories 8 and 9 (printed then as 7 and 8), and «ПОСТУПЛЕНИЯ» (TOTAL) of those years INCLUDES them -- compare REVENUE or the categories across years, not TOTAL; (b) in 19 editions of 2015-2018 a subclass exceeds the specifics printed under it (rows left out of the table): kept as printed, so specifics of those months do not add up to the subclass, while classes, categories and totals do; (c) REP.REVENUE is absent for 2021-01..03, where the cell is printed as 0; (d) six state-budget and one republican month are missing because the table of that edition does not parse or its total contradicts its categories (2017-01, 2017-02, 2018-04, 2018-12, 2021-03, 2021-05; republican 2013-07). Nine items equal their scalar series on every common month (tax revenue, CIT, PIT, VAT, excises, social tax on 98 months; revenue, transfers and the oil export duty on 152-154). HISTORY 2005-2012, loaded 2026-11-14 from the PDF editions (fetchers/minfin_pdf.py; values in whole millions, sums checked with half a million of rounding per term, and a subclass that does not add up drops the table -- no «INCOMPLETE» allowance before 2013): state budget 81 of 96 months, republican 80. Missing -- state: 2005-05, 2005-12, 2006-04, 2006-09, 2006-10, 2007-03, 2007-12, 2008-12, 2009-02, 2010-02, 2011-04 … 2011-08; republican: 2005-01, 2005-03, 2005-05, 2006-04, 2006-09, 2006-10, 2007-03, 2008-05, 2010-03, 2010-04, 2011-02, 2011-04, 2011-07, 2011-09, 2011-10, 2012-11; most are tables that contradict themselves or print one code twice in the source, the reasons are listed in docs/minfin_bulletin_pdf_2005_2012.md. STATE.REVENUE equals STATE_BUDGET_REVENUE (annual 2008-2012, quarterly 2010-2012, year-to-date 2011-2012) on all 20 common dates within 1 million. CODES ARE REUSED OVER TIME: 105306 is «Роялти» until 2008 and the mineral extraction tax from 2009; read item_name. «ПОСТУПЛЕНИЯ» (TOTAL) of 2005-2012 includes the movement of budget balances and can be below «ДОХОДЫ».
